subject: M8 Browser multiplayer client for the Paper bridge
description: The server side already exists: a 1,205-line Paper plugin with hello/join/move/look/block_set/block_break/chat/inv_req/held/chunk_req, palette+RLE chunk sections, armour-stand avatars, event mirroring, RFC 6455 over JDK sockets, rate limiting and token/Origin checks (bridge/paper-plugin, bridge/PROTOCOL.md). The browser client is ABSENT: zero occurrences of WebSocket in src/, Join Server shows a scripted 2.8 s progress message (src/main.ts:338-341), and the bundled ws://127.0.0.1:8765 entry is unreachable by design. Work: a WebSocket protocol client with reconnect, chunk decode into local section storage (depends on M1 state ids and M4 streaming), remote player avatars with interpolation and nameplates, block/place/chat mirroring, an inventory request round-trip, server list ping + MOTD rendering (the server_list sprites are already extracted but never drawn), and a dev proxy in vite.config.ts. Requires explicit user approval before touching the live Paper server at G:/Minecraftserver/DaemonData/Servers/1; use a separate copy for testing.
